summary.headline: SEBO M.E.C. wins KRW 72.4bn Asan mechanical facilities contract from Samsung C&T
summary.what_happened: SEBO Manufacturing Engineering Corporation signed a single supply contract for the Asan mechanical facilities construction project with Samsung C&T Corporation, dated Nov 27, 2026. The contract is unconditional, with a fixed contract amount of KRW 72.4bn (excluding VAT) and runs from Nov 30, 2026 to Jan 31, 2028.

key_numbers.label: Contract amount as % of recent revenue

summary.why_it_matters: Large single supply contracts like this one are typically disclosed under Korean rules because they can materially affect a listed company's future revenue and order backlog. Shareholders often monitor such filings to gauge the scale of new work relative to the company's existing sales.
